en.hubeali: From him, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Muhammad Bin Marwan who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Which of the deeds is the most Beloved to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Your praising Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “
Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘What deed is the most beloved to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy?’ The Imam said, ‘It is your deed of praising Him.’”
